Name: HarpieDiva Farmhouse Renovation
Author: harpiediva
Description:
This mod replaces the beginner, second, and third farmhouse maps. It is all one continuous "floor" so your spouse should be able to access every room.

You WILL need the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]Noclip[/url] Mode mod to adjust furniture between upgrades.
[b]
1.1 Fixes:
[/b][list]
[*]Fixed entrance to cellar in fully upgraded farmhouse.
[*]Fixed the issue with a hallways on the lower half of the map being partially blocked.
[*]Your spouse, baby, and children will no longer enter the walls.
[/list][b]
[/b][b]1.2 Fix:[/b]
[list]
[*]There is now a configurable entrance/exit to the cellar on the left-hand side of the map, next to the lower left bathroom.
[/list]
[b]1.25 Edit:[/b]
[list]
[*]Quick n' dirty edit that allows you to turn off the wainscotting on the "hallway" walls.

[/list][list=1]

[/list][b]
Known issues:[/b]
[list]
[*]There is a little tile in the upper half of the third farmhouse map that's out of place. I have no idea where the map is pulling that tile from, so, until I can hunt it down, it is what it is.
[*]When enabling/disabling the kitchen/greenhouse room, the spouse room will temporarily empty out. Closing and restarting the game should fix this.
[*]Making use of Robin's renovations will kill the map. Lol. Just don't.
[*]If you notice any other issues, please leave a comment and I will take a look at them.
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Quick edit to allow you to turn off the wainscotting on the hallway walls. UPDATED 1/5/25 to correct issues with first upgrade on farmhouse.
